prompt.project_info: Create a warm soft semi-realistic Japanese/kawaii character design sheet based on an approved reference image.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult character with identity and core facial features preserved from the supplied reference, presented in a cozy semi-realistic illustration style.
prompt.composition_elements: Profile poster with one large main portrait, happy/annoyed/sleepy/surprised expressions, running and playful action poses, small object icons, color-palette section, and profile panel containing a replaceable name and personality.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm soft colors, cozy Japanese/kawaii atmosphere, gentle illustrative shading, clean readable design-sheet hierarchy.
prompt.technical_specs: Semi-realistic cartoon illustration, organized character-sheet layout, consistent face and costume across panels, high-resolution clean linework and texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an adorable character design sheet based on the supplied approved-adult reference image. Use a warm, soft, semi-realistic cartoon illustration with cozy Japanese/kawaii styling. Design a profile poster with a large main portrait, facial expressions including happy, annoyed, sleepy, and surprised, action poses such as running and playing based on the character personality, small object icons, a color-palette section, and a profile section with a replaceable name and personality. Preserve the approved adult character's face, identity, core outfit, and color continuity across all panels. Use clean readable layout, gentle shading, warm soft colors, and high-resolution linework.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike sexualization, inconsistent identity, inconsistent outfit, unreadable layout, random text, watermark, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, plastic 3D render, photorealistic mismatch, public figure likeness.
